remarks: Welcome to your new home! This freshly updated 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment combines modern conveniences perfect for your lifestyle. Features you'll love: Interior unit, NEW stylish kitchen with quartz counters, gas cooktop and dishwasher, brand new bath, new light fixtures, balcony overlooking the fountain, rent includes heat, hot water, cooking gas, basic cable, basic internet, amenities, water, sewer and 1 parking spot! WOW! EXTRAS: Common laundry area in the basement, pets considered with landlord approval. AMENITIES: in-ground pool, exercise room, and playground. Gated community & 24-hour security. LOCATION: Walking distance to downtown Stamford. 1.6 miles to the Stamford Train Station! ADDITIONAL DETAILS: Good credit is required.
